title: Morning travel news
instructions: Radyoda sabah ulaşım haberleri. Yolları, sebepleri ve alternatifleri karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Good morning. Here is the travel news.

script.speaker: s
script.text: The M4 motorway is closed between junctions ten and twelve because of an accident. Drivers should use the A4 instead.

script.speaker: s
script.text: In the city centre, there is heavy traffic on Bridge Street because of road works. These will continue until Friday.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Trains are running normally, but there are no trains to the airport this morning because of a problem with the line. There are buses instead, every fifteen minutes.

script.speaker: s
script.text: And if you're going to the football match tonight, the stadium car park is closed. Please use the park-and-ride from the shopping centre.

script.speaker: s
script.text: The next travel news is at nine thirty.

questions.prompt: Which road should drivers use instead of the M4?
questions.evidence: Drivers should use the A4 instead.

questions.prompt: Until when will the road works continue?
How can people get to the airport this morning?
